training_step: MONAI SwinUNETR forward + MSE + backward + Adam update, AMP fp16, activation checkpointing
method: Serial estimates use the current isolated single-process median. Parallel pair estimates use max(fold updates * concurrent per-step median); pair scheduling is sequential across tracers.
limitations: Synthetic tensors only; no real cache I/O or data-loading overhead.
Five updates per process are a short benchmark, not a long-run throughput guarantee.
Estimate excludes periodic recovery writes and possible clock or thermal variation.
No formal OOF training or checkpoint was created.
